entities.summary: The Hôpital Armand-Trousseau is a public Assistance Publique–Hôpitaux de Paris (AP-HP) located at 26, avenue du Docteur-Arnold-Netter and rue Lasson in the 12th arrondissement of Paris. It is one of the sites of the Sorbonne University Hospital Group.
